title: 火薬庫の小さな守り神

format.page_order_on_sheet: rtl_row_major(1p=シート右上、右→左、行送り)

pages.scene: 祭り前夜の雑賀。火薬庫を狙う盗賊をウカが発見

panels.prompt: Wide establishing shot at night. Mountain valley in Saika territory, a large wooden gunpowder warehouse under moonlight and mist. Dramatic color manga, 3-to-4-head chibi anime proportions, clean bold lineart.
Dynamic silhouette of a masked thief running across the warehouse roof carrying a sack of horoku bombs. Moon behind the figure.
Close medium shot of {uka} hiding behind a tree, fox ears twitching, purple eyes sharp, holding red talisman cards, white-and-red ninja outfit and large fox tail.

pages.scene: いぶきが現れ、盗賊を挟み撃ちにするが煙玉で逃げられる

panels.prompt: {ibuki} leaps in from the opposite direction holding a horoku bomb, black ninja outfit with purple accents, blue-purple topknot, green eyes, small green oni companion on shoulder.

dialogue.speaker: Ibuki
dialogue.text: 火薬泥棒！ そこまでだ！

panels.prompt: The thief throws a smoke bomb. Thick smoke explodes between {uka} and {ibuki}; the thief disappears into the darkness.
Inside the smoke, tense two-shot: {uka} and {ibuki} point weapons at each other, both suspicious and soot-streaked.
{ibuki} throws a small horoku bomb toward {uka}, dynamic foreshortening and speed lines.
{uka} flicks a red talisman that wraps the bomb in midair with glowing fox-fire energy.

dialogue.speaker: Uka
dialogue.text: そんな物を人に向けないで

panels.prompt: Small harmless puff explosion covers both girls in soot. Comedic deadpan faces, smoke curls.

dialogue.speaker: Ibuki
dialogue.text: 止めるなら、もう少し優しく止めろ！

pages.scene: 火薬庫そのものに火が付けられていると判明

panels.prompt: Long shot of the thief escaping across a rope bridge over a ravine.
{ibuki} starts to chase, but {uka} grabs her wrist and stops her. Urgent expressions.
Low angle on the warehouse floorboards glowing red from below; smoke and sparks leak through cracks. {uka} realizes the trap.

dialogue.speaker: Uka
dialogue.text: 盗まれたんじゃない。火をつけられた

pages.scene: 大量の焙烙玉が誘爆寸前

panels.prompt: Interior wide shot: hundreds of horoku bombs stacked in rows, three burning fuse lines racing through the warehouse. Dramatic orange lighting.
Close-up of {ibuki} turning pale, green eyes wide, calculating the danger.

dialogue.speaker: Ibuki
dialogue.text: この量が爆発したら、山ごと消える

panels.prompt: {uka} turns calmly toward {ibuki}, holding talismans ready, fire reflected in purple eyes.

pages.scene: 三本の導火線を同時に切る必要がある

panels.prompt: {ibuki} spreads a rough warehouse map on the floor and points to three routes, intense planning scene.
Diagram-like action panel showing three fuse branches, each flame moving toward bomb stacks.

dialogue.speaker: Ibuki
dialogue.text: 全部同時に切らないと逆に誘爆する

panels.prompt: Heroic medium shot of {uka} forming a summoning hand sign, fox-fire beginning to swirl.

pages.scene: ウカが三匹の子狐を口寄せする

panels.prompt: Large dramatic summoning panel: {uka} kneels with hand sign, red talismans and blue-white fox fire spiraling around her.
Three cute small fox spirits appear in puffs of smoke, lined up with determined faces.
panels.sfx: ポンッ ポンッ ポンッ

panels.prompt: {ibuki} stares at the foxes with softened delighted expression; {uka} gives her a suspicious side-eye.

pages.scene: いぶきが油断してヒヨコになる

panels.prompt: {ibuki} is suddenly enveloped in a tiny puff of magical smoke, surprised face vanishing.
Reveal: a tiny yellow chick stands where {ibuki} was, with a hint of blue-purple crest and fierce green eyes. Comedic large panel.
Deadpan {uka} looks down at the chick while the three fox spirits tilt their heads.

pages.scene: ヒヨコ姿のいぶきが作戦を伝える

panels.prompt: Tiny chick {ibuki} flaps angrily on {uka}'s palm, trying to explain; {uka} looks puzzled.

dialogue.speaker: Uka
dialogue.text: 言っていることが分からない

panels.prompt: Chick {ibuki} pecks one central point on the warehouse map repeatedly with fierce determination.
{uka} suddenly understands, pointing at the central bomb store; chick {ibuki} nods sharply.

dialogue.speaker: Uka
dialogue.text: 中央の火薬を先に抜け、ってこと？

pages.scene: 狐たちを配置し、ウカが火薬庫へ突入

panels.prompt: Three fox spirits sprint in three different directions along burning fuse lines, low dynamic angle.

dialogue.speaker: Uka
dialogue.text: 三本とも、火の手前で待って

panels.prompt: {uka} gently tucks chick {ibuki} into the front of her white-and-red outfit, protective expression.
Heroic full-body shot of {uka} charging into the blazing warehouse, fox tail streaming behind, talismans in hand.

pages.scene: 崩落の中、ヒヨコいぶきが中央火薬の留め具へ向かう

panels.prompt: A burning wooden beam crashes down in front of {uka}, sparks and debris everywhere.
Chick {ibuki} jumps out from {uka}'s chest and darts through a narrow gap beneath the fallen beam.
Close-up: chick {ibuki} uses her tiny beak to pull open the metal latch securing the giant central horoku bomb.

pages.scene: 巨大焙烙玉が暴走し、二人で軌道を変える

panels.prompt: Huge central horoku bomb breaks loose and rolls toward the cliff-side exit, crushing crates.
Chick {ibuki} rides on top of the rolling bomb, leaning hard to steer it, tiny wings spread, heroic-comic expression.
{uka} throws several talismans that become glowing paper ropes wrapping around the giant bomb.

dialogue.speaker: Uka
dialogue.text: 一人で格好つけないで

pages.scene: 巨大焙烙玉を谷へ放り出す

panels.prompt: {uka} braces and pulls the talisman ropes with all her strength, fox-fire aura behind her, launching the giant bomb out of the warehouse.
Long vertical view down the dark ravine as the giant bomb falls, chick {ibuki} safely flying back toward {uka} in a fox-fire bubble.
Massive distant explosion blooms in the valley like a fiery flower against the night sky. {uka} and chick {ibuki} silhouetted in foreground.

pages.scene: 爆風の一瞬を使い三本の導火線を同時切断

panels.prompt: Explosion shockwave rushes through the warehouse and briefly blows out the flames on all three fuse lines.
Split-style action panel: three fox spirits bite through the three fuse lines at exactly the same moment.
Wide silent interior. The last sparks die out among stacks of intact bombs; smoke drifts softly.

pages.scene: 夜明け、守れたものを確かめる

panels.prompt: Dawn outside the damaged warehouse. {uka} sits exhausted against a wooden wall, warm sunrise light.
Close shot: chick {ibuki} sleeps peacefully on {uka}'s lap; three fox spirits curl nearby.

dialogue.speaker: Uka
dialogue.text: 逃げた犯人は取り逃がしたけど

panels.prompt: Gentle close-up of {uka} smiling slightly toward the sunrise, ears relaxed.

dialogue.speaker: Uka
dialogue.text: 守るべきものは守れた

pages.scene: いぶきが戻り、ヒヨコ姿をからかわれる

panels.prompt: Morning light. Chick {ibuki} transforms back into her normal blue-purple-haired ninja form in a puff of smoke.
Embarrassed red-faced {ibuki} points at {uka}, demanding secrecy. {uka} wears an innocent expression.

dialogue.speaker: Ibuki
dialogue.text: 今のことは全部忘れろ！

panels.prompt: Final comedy panel: a fox spirit on {uka}'s shoulder imitates a chick and says piyo; furious embarrassed {ibuki} chases it while {uka} laughs. Bright cheerful sunrise.
